mentions.name: True Self CTO
mentions.description: A coaching practice and website through which a former CTO coaches other tech leaders, focusing on the human side of building products and companies — emotional baggage, limiting beliefs, and social dynamics. The website is in early development and shares the coach's approach and story.
mentions.problem: The hardest part of building anything is the human side — emotional baggage, limiting beliefs, and social dynamics — which the author says caused the startups they were part of not to take off.
mentions.audience: Tech leaders (e.g. current and aspiring CTOs)
mentions.source_excerpt: After 9 years as a CTO I'm moving on to coach other tech leaders.

evidence.value: After 9 years as a CTO I'm moving on to coach other tech leaders.
